# eetree-sim 1
# name voltage-multiplier-full
# param VP 14.14
# param f 50
# param C 0.0001
# param RL 10000
# let dt = 1/(f*400)
# let sp = 40
$ 1 ${dt} ${sp} 50 ${VP*2} 50
v 160 256 160 192 0 1 ${f} ${VP} 0 0 0.5
d 64 168 64 120 1 0.805904783
d 64 296 64 248 1 0.805904783
c 256 152 256 200 0 ${C} 0 0
c 256 280 256 328 0 ${C} 0 0
r 352 200 352 248 0 ${RL}
g 304 352 304 368 0 0
207 432 96 464 96 0 VOUT
w 64 96 64 120 0
w 64 168 64 192 0
w 64 192 64 248 0
w 64 296 64 352 0
w 256 96 256 152 0
w 256 200 256 256 0
w 256 256 256 280 0
w 256 328 256 352 0
w 160 192 64 192 0
w 160 256 256 256 0
w 64 96 256 96 0
w 256 96 352 96 0
w 64 352 256 352 0
w 256 352 304 352 0
w 304 352 352 352 0
w 352 96 352 200 0
w 352 248 352 352 0
w 352 96 432 96 0
x 64 56 264 60 0 18 全波倍压整流（Delon 桥式）
x 64 408 264 412 0 14 电容按计算器中的 C 取相同值；V1 峰值 ${si(VP)}V、${si(f)}Hz，负载 RL ＝ ${si(RL)}Ω
o 0 2 0 4098 ${VP*2} 0.01 0 2 7 0
o 7 64 0 4098 ${VP*2} 0.01 1 1
